messages:
Maya Patel: Quick Q — bought a prepaid SIM + 5GB top-up at AMS kiosk during a 5-day customer trip. Total €45. Used ~2 days for customer calls, rest personal. Receipt attached. Do I expense the full amount or split? Any airport telecom rules?

Juan (People Ops): Reimbursable when business-critical. Short answer: claim the business portion, attach the itemized receipt, and include manager approval in notes.

Maya Patel: I didn’t get preapproval — do I need retro sign-off?

Juan (People Ops): No retro preapproval needed for small telecom buys. If over €75, please get manager or #people-ops sign-off before submitting. Use expense category "mobile-internet".

Oliver Kim: I approve the business portion. @Maya confirm how many days were work-related and add a short note. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Thanks. Do we pro-rate by days or by data used?

Elena (Accounting): Days-based pro-rate is preferred for privacy. So 2/5 = 40% business. Claim 40% of €45 = €18. Add note: "2/5 days business — approved by Oliver Kim" and attach the receipt.

Finance Bot: Reminder: upload original itemized receipt (photo/pdf). If charged in non-EUR we use the card rate on the statement; if cash, accounting uses the exchange rate for the expense date.

Juan (People Ops): Policy highlights: airport kiosk receipts must be itemized (SIM/data). Generic card slips without item detail may be rejected. Purchases including hardware or device components > €150 require preapproval and asset tagging. For mixed personal/business use, include manager attestation in the notes.

Maya Patel: Receipt is itemized and I paid cash. I’ll submit with 40% and Oliver’s approval in notes. Anything about VAT reclaim?

Elena (Accounting): We only reclaim VAT if the vendor issues a VAT invoice in the company name. Kiosk sales rarely provide that. Submit normally; VAT will not be reclaimed in this case.

Juan (People Ops): Policy snippet: telecom & mobile data reimbursable when needed for customer work, receipt required, pro-rate personal use, preapproval required for purchases > €75. Link: <https://redwood.company/policies/expenses#telecom>

Maya Patel: Thanks — submitting now with 40% claim.

Oliver Kim: Approved.

Elena (Accounting): Received — processing at 40% and marking as non-VAT reclaimable. I will follow up if anything else is needed.
